edges.description: Loss of the predicted interface contacts may impair early assembly.
Reduced availability of a required structural subunit impairs assembly.
The assembly defect reduces steady-state holoenzyme abundance.
A smaller pool of mature complex IV lowers measured oxidase capacity.
The available complex IV is distributed differently among monomeric and higher-order assemblies.
Respiratory-chain dysfunction is associated with lactate accumulation; the intervening flux changes were not measured in these patients.
Complex IV dysfunction is associated with pulmonary vascular disease in the founding siblings; vascular-cell mechanisms remain unresolved.
Mitochondrial dysfunction contributes to growth failure through incompletely defined systemic pathways.
Elevated circulating lactate is the measured clinical manifestation.

evidence.reference_title: Novel insights into the assembly and function of human nuclear-encoded cytochrome c oxidase subunits 4, 5a, 6a, 7a and 7b.
evidence.snippet: Knockdown of Cox4, Cox5a and Cox6a resulted in reduced CcO activity, diminished affinity of the residual enzyme for oxygen, decreased holoCcO and CcO dimer levels, increased accumulation of CcO subcomplexes and gave rise to an altered pattern of respiratory supercomplexes.

nodes.description: Copper chloride increased complex IV abundance in cultured p.Arg107Cys patient fibroblasts. The COX1 assembly intermediate persisted; a translation-inhibition experiment was consistent with stabilization of residual complexes or subassemblies. These experiments do not establish a safe or effective clinical treatment.

accumulation of COX1 did not resolve in CuCl2-treated ﬁbroblasts, suggesting another mechanism of complex IV rescue.

nodes.description: High-calorie nasogastric feeding was used for the elder founder sibling, but weight gain remained poor. This documents supportive use, not demonstrated disease modification.

evidence.snippet: she was discharged on a high calorie diet applied via nasogas- tric tube feeding. However, weight gain remained poor.
